facts.text: The Promise Scholarship supports up to 100 scholars each year to help underserved young achievers from Maine graduate in four years with little or no debt.

sources.title: About us – The Promise Scholarship - University of Southern Maine
sources.quote: The Promise Scholarship is designed to help underserved young achievers from Maine overcome financial, academic, social, and cultural barriers, remain in school, and graduate in four years with little or no debt

sources.title: About us – The Promise Scholarship - University of Southern Maine
sources.quote: Our program supports up to 100 scholars every year – approximately 25 in each class – with multi-year, equitable scholarship awards
